title: Latency/$ Benchmark Report — Launch Checklist & Owners (v1)
content:
DOC NOTES (read me first)
- Launch target (public): Tue 2025-02-25 @ 09:00 PT
- Goal: publish benchmark landing page + report PDF + blog + public tables; align PR/analyst + field enablement + support readiness.
- Status key: NS=not started | IP=in progress | BLK=blocked | DONE=done | RISK=at risk
- Owner is DRI (can list supporting names in Notes).
- All external claims must follow Confluence “public-benchmarking-claims-guidelines”.

TAB: MASTER CHECKLIST (spreadsheet-style)
Columns: Workstream | Task | DRI | Due (local) | Status | Dependencies | Notes / Links

- Over-claim risk: ensure social/email subject lines remain within approved language.
- Table hosting: confirm cache/versioning allows rollback without breaking landing page links.
